- Rubric (short): Correctness, Engineering tradeoffs & clarity, Telemetry & testing approach, Production-readiness suggestions. Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-debrief-rubric
- Debrief owner: Karthik (primary), Marissa (notes)
